tool_analysis: Step Analysis: The recorded browser session navigated Magento 1 admin Manage Products, demonstrated clicking Add Product, filled grid filters (ID range, Name, SKU, Price, Qty, Type, Attribute Set), applied Search, attempted a mass-action (Change status -> Disabled) and finally opened the Edit page for product id 2798 and changed status via the Edit form when mass-action failed. Task Definition: A reusable tool that navigates to the Magento admin product grid, applies user-supplied filters, optionally performs a mass-action, and opens the first matching product's Edit page. Action Plan: 1) Navigate to Manage Products; 2) (Demonstration) Click Add Product then return; 3) Fill all grid filter controls with provided inputs; 4) Optionally select mass-action and its sub-controls; 5) Click Search to apply filters; 6) Select the first matching row checkbox and submit mass-action (if requested); 7) Open the Edit link for the first match; 8) Extract the Edit page summary for verification. Variable Identification: inputs required - product_id_from, product_id_to, filter_name, filter_sku, price_from, price_to, qty_from, qty_to, filter_type, filter_attribute_set, filter_visibility, filter_status, filter_website, mass_action, mass_action_status, open_edit. Step Optimization: Replaced exploratory clicks and UI traversal with deterministic navigation to the Manage Products URL and used stable elementHash values recorded from the session for each interactable control. Combined short waits where asynchronous updates are expected. For environments where JavaScript is disabled the mass-action may not complete; the tool still navigates to Edit for a reliable fallback. The tool intentionally fills every filter input (pass empty string to skip) to avoid conditional branching in the step sequence. Selectors: elementHash values used map to the exact elements interacted with during recording; if your Magento admin theme or grid id differs, replace elementHash-based steps with the equivalent CSS/XPath selectors noted in the session logs. Execution Notes: All inputs are optional; pass empty strings for filters you don't want to apply. The agent is already authenticated in the recorded session, so the tool assumes the caller runs in an authenticated admin context.
name: magento_admin_find_and_open_product
description: Navigate to Magento 1 admin Manage Products, apply product grid filters (ID, name, SKU, price range, qty range, type, attribute set, visibility, status, website), run Search, optionally perform a mass-action, and open the product Edit page. Uses deterministic element hashes recorded during a successful run to target controls. All filter inputs are parameterized so callers can pass empty strings for fields they do not want to set.

steps.description: Open Manage Products grid (starting page).
Brief wait for grid to render. Adjust in caller environment if needed.
Click the 'Add Product' header action to demonstrate the Add Product control (recorded elementHash).
Return to Manage Products page (after demonstrating Add Product) using direct navigation to ensure deterministic state.
Set ID 'From' filter (pass empty string to leave blank).
Set ID 'To' filter (pass empty string to leave blank).
Set Name filter input.
Set SKU filter input.
Set Price 'From' filter (if empty, leaves blank).
Set Qty 'From' filter (if empty, leaves blank).
Set Qty 'To' filter (if empty, leaves blank).
Select Product Type (visible option text). Pass empty string to leave as-is.
Select Attribute Set (visible option text). Pass empty string to leave as-is.
Select mass-action from 'Actions' dropdown. If empty, no mass-action will be performed (select_change will be a no-op if empty).
Click the grid 'Search' button to apply filters and refresh the product grid.
Wait for grid to update after Search. Increase if environment uses slow AJAX or rendering.

Click the checkbox for the first matching product row (checkbox value=product id). This selects the row for mass-action. If no mass_action provided, selecting is still performed to allow edit or verification.
If mass_action required a sub-select (e.g. Change status), set the sub-control to the desired value (e.g. 'Disabled'). Pass empty string if not applicable.
Click the mass-action 'Submit' button to execute the chosen action. If {mass_action} is empty this will still click the recorded Submit element (harmless no-op).
Wait for mass-action to process (confirmation or grid update).
Click the Edit link for the first matching product (href contains '/catalog_product/edit/id/{id}/').
Wait for the Edit page to load after clicking the Edit link.
Extract page content on the Edit page (Status select value, Save confirmations, and product identifiers).
steps.goal: Capture product edit page confirmation and the Status field value to verify product opened and (optionally) saved status.

input_schema.name: product_id_from
input_schema.description: Product ID (From) range - maps to grid ID 'From' filter (use empty string to skip).

input_schema.name: product_id_to
input_schema.description: Product ID (To) range - maps to grid ID 'To' filter (use empty string to skip).

input_schema.name: filter_name
input_schema.description: Product name filter text (exact or partial).

input_schema.name: filter_type
input_schema.description: Product Type visible text (e.g. 'Simple Product'). Matches visible option text in Type select.

input_schema.name: filter_attribute_set
input_schema.description: Attribute Set visible text (e.g. 'Default'). Matches visible option text in Attribute Set select.

input_schema.name: mass_action
input_schema.description: Mass-action visible text to select (e.g. 'Change status', 'Delete', 'Update Attributes'). Leave empty to skip mass-action.

input_schema.name: mass_action_status
input_schema.description: When mass_action='Change status', select this status option (e.g. 'Disabled' or 'Enabled'). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: open_edit
input_schema.description: If true (default), open the Edit page for the first matching product after Search/mass-action. Set false to stop after applying filters/mass-action.
